0022600026.text: The Boston Celtics (6-2, second in the Atlantic and third in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-5, third in the Southeast and ninth in the East, on a four-game losing streak), with Boston 5-0 at home but 1-2 on the road. Boston is without Devin Carter (illness), Jayson Tatum (rest) and Payton Pritchard, who is day-to-day with an eye abrasion and is a game-time decision, while Charlotte is missing Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness). The teams have not met yet this season, and Boston won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 113-102 win in Boston on April 7.
